focus.title: 美国拟对东南亚四国光伏产品加征反倾销税，中国转口企业面临合规风险
focus.summary: 美国商务部初步裁定，对来自越南、泰国、马来西亚和柬埔寨的光伏电池及组件征收反倾销税，税率最高达271%。此举旨在堵截中国光伏企业通过东南亚转口规避关税的路径。出口企业需立即审查供应链原产地规则，调整出口路径，并评估反倾销应诉的必要性。
focus.title_en: US Proposes Anti-Dumping Duties on Solar Products from Four Southeast Asian Countries, China Re-Exporters Face Compliance Risks
focus.summary_en: The US Department of Commerce preliminarily ruled to impose anti-dumping duties of up to 271% on solar cells and modules from Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and Cambodia. The move aims to block Chinese solar companies from circumventing tariffs via Southeast Asia. Exporters must urgently review supply chain origin rules, adjust export routes, and evaluate the need for anti-dumping defense.

case.title: 英国高等法院确认：跨境独家经销协议中的仲裁条款效力及于非签署方关联公司
case.summary: 在2026年6月的判决中，英国高等法院裁定，一份中英企业间的独家经销协议中的仲裁条款，可约束未签署协议的母公司及关联公司，因其实际参与了协议的履行与争议交易。该案提示中国企业：在签署跨境合同时，应明确约定仲裁条款的适用范围，避免关联方被意外纳入仲裁程序。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院 · 2026年6月
case.title_en: UK High Court Confirms: Arbitration Clause in Cross-Border Exclusive Distribution Agreement Extends to Non-Signatory Affiliates
case.summary_en: In a June 2026 ruling, the UK High Court held that an arbitration clause in an exclusive distribution agreement between a Chinese and a UK company could bind the non-signatory parent and affiliates, as they were actively involved in performing the agreement and the disputed transactions. This case reminds Chinese enterprises to clearly define the scope of arbitration clauses in cross-border contracts to avoid unintended inclusion of affiliates.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区出台跨境数据流动“正面清单”，覆盖11个行业助力企业合规
policy.summary: 广东省网信办于2026年7月发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全评估管理指引（试行）》，明确金融、医疗、跨境电商等11个行业的数据出境“正面清单”，简化安全评估程序。企业可对照清单进行数据分类分级，提前准备合规材料，降低跨境数据传输的法律风险。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年7月
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Issues 'Positive List' for Cross-Border Data Flows, Covering 11 Industries to Aid Compliance
policy.summary_en: In July 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province released the 'Guidelines on Security Assessment for Cross-Border Data Flows in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', specifying a 'positive list' for data export in 11 industries including finance, healthcare, and cross-border e-commerce, streamlining security assessment procedures. Enterprises can classify data according to the list, prepare compliance materials in advance, and reduce legal risks in cross-border data transfers.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · July 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国新增半导体对华出口管制，企业应建立“动态合规清单”
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）近期扩大了对先进半导体设备及EDA软件的出口管制范围，新增受限物项清单。实务建议：企业应建立动态合规清单，定期比对BIS实体清单与ECCN编码变化；对涉及美国技术来源的产品，需进行全供应链溯源；建议设立内部出口管制合规官，并开展全员培训。 Attorney Qin's view: The BIS has expanded export controls on advanced semiconductor equipment and EDA software, adding new restricted items. Practical advice: Companies should establish a dynamic compliance list, regularly cross-check BIS entity list and ECCN code changes; conduct full supply chain tracing for products involving US-origin technology; consider appointing an internal export control compliance officer and conduct company-wide training.
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: New US Semiconductor Export Controls on China – Companies Should Establish a 'Dynamic Compliance List'
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The BIS has recently expanded export controls on advanced semiconductor equipment and EDA software, adding new restricted items. Practical advice: Companies should establish a dynamic compliance list, regularly cross-check BIS entity list and ECCN code changes; conduct full supply chain tracing for products involving US-origin technology; consider appointing an internal export control compliance officer and conduct company-wide training.
